description: Collect, manage, and share testimonials with Senja.

auth.description:
To get your Senja API key:
1. Log in to your Senja account.
2. Go to **Automate** in the left sidebar.
3. Click **REST API** and copy your API key.

list_testimonials.name: list_testimonials
list_testimonials.description: Retrieve all testimonials from your Senja project.

query.description: Full-text search across testimonial text, title, customer name, customer email, and customer tagline.

sort.description: Field used to sort the results.

approved.description: Filter by approval status. Leave empty to return all testimonials.

type.description: Filter by testimonial type. Leave empty to return all types.

rating.description: Filter testimonials by star rating (1 to 5).

integration.description: Filter testimonials by their source platform (e.g. Google, Twitter).

tags.description: Filter testimonials that have all of the specified tags.

lang.description: Filter by language using an ISO 639 code (e.g. "en", "fr", "de").

limit.description: Maximum number of testimonials to return (1–1000).

page.description: Page number for pagination. Start at 1.

aiMetadata.description: Lists testimonials from a Senja project, returning all of them or only those matching optional filters (full-text search, approval status, type, rating, source platform, tags, language) with sorting and pagination. Use to find, audit, or enumerate testimonials before acting on them. Read-only and idempotent.

get_testimonial.name: get_testimonial
get_testimonial.description: Retrieve a specific testimonial by its ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the testimonial. You can find it in the URL when viewing a testimonial in Senja, or from the output of a "List Testimonials" step.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Senja testimonial by its unique ID. Use when you already have a testimonial ID (e.g. from List Testimonials or a trigger) and need its full details. Requires the testimonial ID; read-only and idempotent.

create_testimonial.name: create_testimonial
create_testimonial.description: Add a new testimonial to your Senja project.

type.description: Choose "Text" for a written testimonial or "Video" for a video testimonial.

customer_name.description: Full name of the person giving the testimonial.

title.description: A short headline for the testimonial.

text.description: The body of the testimonial. Required for text testimonials.

approved.description: Check to mark the testimonial as approved immediately. Leave unchecked to keep it pending.

date.description: Date the testimonial was given. Leave empty to use today's date.

url.description: Link to the original testimonial (e.g. a tweet URL, Google review link).

video_url.description: URL of the video testimonial. Required when Testimonial Type is "Video".

customer_company.description: Company or organisation the customer belongs to.

customer_tagline.description: Short role or tagline for the customer (e.g. "CEO at Acme").

customer_username.description: Social media handle or username of the customer (e.g. "@johndoe").

customer_url.description: Link to the customer's social profile or website.

customer_avatar.description: Direct URL to the customer's profile picture.

customer_company_logo.description: Direct URL to the customer's company logo.

integration.description: The platform where this testimonial originally came from.

tags.description: Tags to attach to this testimonial for organisation and filtering.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the thumbnail image for this testimonial.

form_id.description: ID of the Senja form to associate this testimonial with.

media.description: List of image URLs to attach to this testimonial. Each entry must be a JSON object with a "url" field and optionally "alt" text, e.g. {"url": "https://...", "alt": "description"}.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new testimonial in a Senja project, either a text or a video testimonial (set by type). Use to import or record a customer testimonial along with its customer details, rating, tags, and source. Requires type and customer name; text needs body text and video needs a video URL. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate testimonial.

update_testimonial.name: update_testimonial
update_testimonial.description: Approve, unapprove, or update tags on an existing testimonial.

id.description: The unique ID of the testimonial. You can find it in the URL when viewing a testimonial in Senja, or from the output of a "List Testimonials" step.

approved.description: Set to "Approved" to publish the testimonial, or "Pending" to unpublish it. Leave empty to keep the current status.

add_tags.description: Tag names to add to this testimonial. Tags are created automatically if they do not already exist.

remove_tags.description: Tag names to remove from this testimonial.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Senja testimonial identified by ID, changing its approval status and/or adding or removing tags. Use to publish/unpublish a testimonial or manage its tags. Requires the testimonial ID and at least one of approval status, tags to add, or tags to remove, or the call fails. Idempotent — applying the same change yields the same final state.

delete_testimonial.name: delete_testimonial
delete_testimonial.description: Permanently delete a testimonial from your Senja project. This action cannot be undone.

id.description: The unique ID of the testimonial to delete. You can find it in the URL when viewing a testimonial in Senja, or from the output of a "List Testimonials" step.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Senja testimonial by its ID; this cannot be undone. Use only when you intend to remove a testimonial for good. Requires the testimonial ID. Not idempotent — the testimonial exists only on the first successful call and a repeat targets a missing resource.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

testimonial_event.name: testimonial_event
testimonial_event.description: Triggers when a testimonial is created, updated, or deleted in Senja.

instructions.description:
## Setup Instructions

1. In Senja, go to **Automate** in the left sidebar and scroll down to the Webhooks section.
2. Click **Create webhook**.
3. Paste the following URL into the webhook URL field:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Select the events you want to receive and click **Save**.

events.description: Only trigger for the selected event types. Leave empty to trigger on all events. Make sure the matching events are enabled in Senja.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a testimonial is created, updated, or deleted in Senja, delivering the affected testimonial via a manually configured webhook. Can be filtered to only the selected event types (created, updated, deleted) or left to fire on all of them.

fr.## Setup Instructions\n\n1. In Senja, go:
## Instructions de configuration

1. Dans Senja, allez à **Automatique** dans la barre latérale gauche et descendez jusqu'à la section Webhooks.
2. Cliquez sur **Créer un webhook**.
3. Collez l'URL suivante dans le champ URL du webhook :
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Sélectionnez les événements que vous souhaitez recevoir et cliquez sur **Enregistrer**.
fr.Only trigger for the selected event type: Déclencher uniquement pour les types d'événements sélectionnés. Laissez vide pour déclencher sur tous les événements. Assurez-vous que les événements correspondants sont activés dans Senja.
